expectation: Membrane/surface ring on a subset of myeloid cells (monocytes, macrophages). Moderately common, as scattered single cells or clusters in stroma and infiltrates, absent from most tumour or epithelial cells, and varying between regions.
observed: A: yellow forms fibrous or cell-outline networks that differ strongly between ROIs, with dense clumps in one ROI and little in others. B/C: patchy, low-contrast cell-shaped signal, with many nuclei unstained. D: yellow rims hug the nuclei, and some nuclei have none.
why: Signal is a membrane-like outline on a subset of cells in clumps, varies between ROIs, and leaves many nuclei unstained, as expected for CD14 on myeloid cells.
